title: jams engine animation, format v1

$schema.description: The animation JSON Schema this file follows.

atlas.description: The atlas asset whose frames the clips show.

name.description: The clip's name, which `anim` blocks and `next` use.

tag.description: An atlas tag whose frames and direction the clip takes; `frames` overrides them by index.

frames.description: The clip's frames in order; with `tag`, each replaces the tag's frame at its index.

ms.description: How long the frame shows, rounded to whole ticks; default the atlas's, else 100.

events.description: Raised as `anim:frame` events on the tick the frame is entered.

shapes.description: Named shape sets (hitboxes, hurtboxes) that game code queries; set names are lowercase with dashes.

items.description: A shape tuple, local to the sprite's anchor: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?] | ["circle", cx, cy, r] | ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?] | ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...] | ["chain", x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]. Metres, y is down; rotDeg in degrees.

loop.description: loop wraps; once stops on its last frame and ends; pingpong runs back and forth; hold stops on its last frame without ending. Default: the tag's direction, else loop.

next.description: For a once clip: the clip that follows; omitted, it holds its last frame.

items.description: One clip: a tag of the atlas, its own frames, or both.

clips.description: The clips, keyed by name and co-edited per clip.

description: Clips over one atlas, with per-frame durations, events and shape sets, played on the simulation's ticks.
